en.hubeali:
And by his chain, he said, 
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘The one for whom the kindness is apportioned to, the Emān would be apportioned to him (as well)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever has received a share of friendliness has received a share of belief.”
